messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: multi-gpu training job stalled on cluster-prod-2, node gpu-node-12. Auto-incident created. Symptoms: all ranks stuck at collective op, no new logs for ~45s. Priority: P1. Paging oncall-ml.

Maya (oncall-ml): i'm on it, pulling logs now. which job / customer? any red/amber alerts in console?

Ashwin: job_id=job-89fa3, owner=customer-acme. Console shows a spike of `ncclCommHang` errors then container restart on gpu-node-12. metric: 14% error rate for tp4 jobs on node.

Maya (oncall-ml): can someone paste the last container logs (stderr) and dmesg XID lines? need driver/kernel hints.

Ashwin: here are the last few lines from the trainer container before it hung:

```
INFO: starting tensor/pipeline sync
rank 0: entering allreduce
rank 2: ncclComm: Timeout waiting for recv
E2026-03-15 12:43:21.874 UTC cuda driver: Xid 79, GPU a100-0: GPU page fault or fault recovery
WARNING: nvlink link 1 flapping
FATAL: unhandled exception in comm thread, aborting
```

and dmesg snippet:
```
[123456.789] NVRM: Xid (79): GPU has fallen off the bus.
[123456.790] kernel: NVRM: GPU watchdog: Hang detected
```

Tom SRE: Xid 79 + nvlink flaps strongly suggests transient hardware/driver issue. node shows repeated PCI resets in syslog. I'm going to cordon/drain the node. command: `kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

Carla-Eng: before draining, can we get a core dump/stacktrace from the trainer? if process crashed we might be able to see where the collective blocked. also capture `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION` and `nvidia-bug-report.sh` if possible.

Maya (oncall-ml): Ashwin — can you snapshot the pod logs and upload to s3? we need logs for postmortem and to notify ACME. Also update support ticket.

Ashwin: done. uploaded s3://redwood-incidents/3950000123/job-89fa3-logs.tar.gz. Added correlation id 9f3b.

Ryan: customer ACME running 3 production training fleets; impact: 2/6 runs hit failures and auto-restarted, visible slowdown. I'm drafting a customer update: short blurb + mitigation steps.

Maya (oncall-ml): mitigation performed: cordoned gpu-node-12, restarted kube-scheduler pods, requeued affected jobs to other nodes with single-gpu fallback turned off. also changed NCCL env for new runs: `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` to avoid flaky p2p on this node until HW validated.

Tom SRE: performed node remediation: rebooted host, replaced PCIe slot assignment on GPU 0 in host firmware, kernel logs clear so far. I set node to unschedulable until EOD.

Carla-Eng: root-cause hypothesis: leader rank in TP pipeline held a blocking collective while CUDA driver hit Xid79 due to NVLink/PCIe transient fault. that left other ranks waiting, causing the runtime to hang instead of failing fast. also saw container OOM in warmup on another job (KV cache + oversized batch) but that's separate.

Maya (oncall-ml): action items for handoff -> eng-runtime: 1) add faster detect/fail for blocked collectives (timeout vs deadlock), 2) improve logging to include rank+tensor id at entry/exit of collective ops, 3) consider automatic per-job fallback to lower parallelism when Xid recurring.

Carla-Eng: logging note: add a small periodic heartbeat from comm thread to detect stall earlier. can gate behind debug flag.

sre-bot: Handoff: oncall-ml -> eng-runtime at 3950000250. Paging cleared for oncall. Link to incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/incident/3950000123

Maya (oncall-ml): left a note in the support ticket for ACME: short summary + that jobs requeued and node cordoned, HW team investigating NVLink flaps. will send full postmortem after eng-runtime analysis. :white_check_mark:

Ryan: customer message posted to ACME slack channel and email — they appreciate the quick reroute but want timeline for fix. assigned PM follow-up.

Tom SRE: I will run full burn-in on replacement node hardware tomorrow and escalate to vendor if nvlink errors reappear.

Carla-Eng: marking severity and next steps in tracker: SEC-3950000123. will kick off a regression test: synthetic tp/pp allreduce loops under NVLink stress.

Maya (oncall-ml): closing pager for this thread — oncall pass to eng-runtime for deeper debug. keeping incident doc open for postmortem.

IncidentBot: Incident status changed: Escalated -> Mitigated.

Tom SRE: follow-up note (12:56 UTC): observed one more Xid79 on spare but was recovered automatically, no customer impact. continuing validation. :mag:

Carla-Eng: (post-handoff) quick snippet of recommended runtime tweak to avoid hang:
```
# detect stalled collectives after 30s and abort rank
if comm_op_time > 30s:
  log.warn("collective stall, aborting rank", rank)
  abort_collective(rank)
```

Maya (oncall-ml): thanks everyone — handing off formal postmortem to eng-runtime.

sre-bot: On-call handover complete.
